description: Remove a WBS number from the registry entirely (FR-007).

wbsNumber.description: The existing WBS number to remove, URL-encoded (may contain '.' characters)

forbidden_403.body: you are not authorized to access this resource

body.message: WBS number not found in registry: {wbsNumber}

side_effects: Permanently deletes the matching WbsNotification document — no soft-delete/undo
notes: Removing a WBS number that does not exist returns 404 rather than succeeding silently, per FR-009 and spec.md User Story 4 Acceptance Scenario 2
